purpose: have the named change authority approve or reject a production change after seeing its risk, evidence and rollback
entry_criteria: Release readiness has a GO or CONDITIONAL record
procedure: Submit the change request with scope, risk, window, rollback and monitoring owner.
Check for conflicts with other changes or freezes in the window.
Change board reviews the evidence; asks for missing items rather than assuming them.
Board decides approve, reject or approve with conditions; the decision is recorded with names and time.
Approval is bound to the specific release id and window; a different build needs a new approval.
Notify implementers, support and stakeholders of the decision.
acceptance_criteria: Decision is made by the named approver, not the requester
Approval names the release id and window

validation.check: compare release id in the approval with the build to be deployed
confirm approver is not the requester or implementer

failure_modes.mode: Approval reused for a different build

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A config change to payment retries is approved for Tuesday 02:00 with the condition that the on-call SRE watches error rate for one hour afterwards.
